scope: Experiment design and local prototype event contract. No production analytics or experiment result.

events.name: asset_export
events.trigger: Browser download initiated; not proof download was retained

localStorage: Only explicit Save action persists draft copy and choices. Media bytes never persist. Restore invalidates media.present.

experiment.hypothesis: A concrete task-first entry may help first-time creators complete a self-checked draft.
experiment.allocation: Proposed only: randomize by creator, stable assignment; this demo switches manually.
experiment.primaryMetric: Unique drafts with all self-checks passed / unique drafts started
experiment.analysis: Predefine sample size and observation window. Check allocation and instrumentation. Report uncertainty and denominator. Do not infer success from clicks alone.
